title: Solid wood and manufactured boards
intro: A material family is not a complete specification. Identify its structure, then compare the actual products and supporting data before selecting construction details.
goals: Request data for the actual product
Relate the material to the whole construction

sections.title: Identify the material structure
sections.text: Inspect an identified cross-section. Distinguish solid wood and its grain from plywood veneer layers and an MDF fibre-based panel. A facing can hide the core, so specify core and face separately. A wood appearance does not establish that the entire board is solid timber.
sections.caption: The cross-section separates core from facing.

sections.title: Request data for the actual product
sections.text: Record the product code, thickness, sheet size, grade and declared use. Request data relevant to the environment and proposed fixing system. Do not infer water resistance or joint capacity from a family name alone; different grades and constructions require review of the actual product data.
sections.caption: Connect performance claims to an identified product and grade.

sections.title: Relate the material to the whole construction
sections.text: Compare alternatives for the same part and use. Review core, thickness, facing, edges, joints and finish as a system, and record missing data. If the product changes after drawing issue, recheck details, schedules and samples. The same colour does not establish the same construction requirements.
sections.caption: Product substitution triggers a review of details and schedules.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: Two veneered boards look alike but have different cores and grades. The brief is a cabinet in a dry interior; hinge and fixing compatibility are still unconfirmed.
example.decision: Decision: compare product data and joint details before accepting a substitute based on appearance.

quiz.question: What supports accepting a board substitution?
options: Product data and compatible construction for the stated use
quiz.explanation: A matching facing does not establish core identity or fixing compatibility.

assignment.prompt: Compare two identified products and list the data still needed before selection.
criteria: The product and grade are identified

faq.question: Should I immediately choose the cheaper sheet?
faq.answer: First confirm compatibility, then compare the whole cost including edges, finishing, waste and supply.
